filters.selection: GitHub search `is:issue is:closed linked:pr` (closing-link index), sorted closed-date desc
filters.bot_filter: issue+PR authors with GitHub account type Bot, or login matching known bot patterns (dependabot/renovate/actions/...), are dropped and counted
filters.closing_pr_rule: tiered: 'merge_closed' = merged PR within closed_at +/- 120s (the merge closed the issue); 'linked_merged' = merged cross-referenced PR (GitHub linked:pr index) within [issue.created_at, closed_at + 14d] when maintainers closed manually first (close_before_merge flagged); tier recorded per record
filters.privacy: no author logins stored; body kept as length+sha256 only; title truncated to 280 chars
